item.title: Brants party
item.description: Kathryn Sherrill of Bellevue zeros in on a flock of brants, a goose-like bird that migrates as far south as Baja California, that had just landed in the Salish Sea at Point Hudson in Port Townsend.

item.title: What type of pet names do you prefer?
PREP BASKETBALL: PA smothers Orting 48-33 to move on in playoffs
item.description: PORT ANGELES — It wasn’t especially pretty, but the Port Angeles boys basketball team toughed out a gritty, 48-33 defensive win over a physical Orting team in the opening round of the District 3 2A tournament.

item.title: Fire district extinguishes RV fire in Sequim Sunday morning
item.description: Firefighters with Clallam County Fire District 3 extinguished an RV fire early Sunday morning near Station 34.

item.title: GIRLS FLAG FOOTBALL: Port Angeles girls upset Klahowya, finish third at state
item.description: FEDERAL WAY — The Port Angeles girls flag football team got a measure of revenge against Klahowya on Saturday, but more importantly, they finished third in the state in the team’s inaugural year on the gridiron.

item.title: COLLEGE BASKETBALL: Peninsula splits pair of games on the road at Edmonds
item.description: EDMONDS — The Peninsula College women won their 51st straight game in the North Region by 52 points, while the men lost to Edmonds 89-74, falling out of playoff position with three region games left.
